summary: Payette NF lookout in Adams County: a 1930s cabin with Roy Bethel as known staff in 1942; sources disagree on whether it was abandoned or removed.

facts.status_note: Sources differ: abandoned (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts), removed (Forest Lookouts), ground gone (FFLA list). None dates the change and none describes the site now.

staffing.status: known staff listed for 1942: Roy Bethel

access.note: On Payette National Forest land. No source says the site is closed or restricted, and none describes the site now. The level is an inference from the land status.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site hike-in. None of the four pages gives a route.

events.note: Cabin, dated only to the 1930s by firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts. The year is the decade start only.
Roy Bethel listed as known lookout staff.

evidence.quote: Crooked River Point Adams 44.85882 -116.69403 Ground Gone

evidence.supports: 1930s cabin, abandoned, Roy Bethel known staff 1942
evidence.quote: 1930s: cabin. Abandoned. Known lookout personnel: 1942: Roy Bethel.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts names the site Crooked River Peak

sources.title: Crooked River Point Fire Lookout Cabin

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say abandoned, Forest Lookouts says removed, and the FFLA list says ground gone. The record's status 'gone' follows the FFLA list and Forest Lookouts. The story says the sources differ and gives no date for any change.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: four short entries, and the Forest Lookouts entry is two lines. The FFLA coordinates (44.85882, -116.69403) and the Idaho Fire Lookouts-linked coordinates (44.8588, -116.6946) agree within about 50 m. Status is unsettled: 'abandoned' (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) does not necessarily mean the cabin is gone, and 'removed' and 'ground gone' come from the other two. No source dates any change. The Forest Lookouts page gives the other name Crooked River Peak. The Payette Crooked River Trail #235 page was checked and does not mention the lookout, so it is not cited. Access level 'public' is inferred from land status. Corrections: none.
